prompts.dino-stumble-06a:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE transparent full-body game animation sprite, intermediate recovery after a gentle stumble.
Input images: image 1 is the immediately preceding low push-up pose (reference only); image 2 is the immediately following upright pose (reference only).
Primary request: Draw ONE new in-between pose HALFWAY BETWEEN these two reference poses. The same dinosaur has just pushed himself off the ground: BOTH feet are firmly planted on the same baseline and in approximately the same positions as image 2, knees still visibly bent, torso halfway raised with head lower and a little farther RIGHT than image 2. Both hands have just left the ground and are rising toward the waist, elbows softly bent, hands relaxed. Arms are still LOW, not at shoulder height. Maintain exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs. This should connect the seated/low pose to standing in a natural smooth recovery. Same friendly smile, same brown eyes, identical dinosaur identity and soft 3D children's game illustration style.
Composition: square transparent canvas, character centered and FULLY visible including toes, tail and bandana tips; exact apparent body size and baseline like image 2, tail extending behind on viewer's LEFT, same camera and three-quarter-right orientation. Entire feet stay near y=0.965 of canvas like image 2.
Materials and colors: green body, dark forest green spikes/spots, cream muzzle/belly/toes, red cloth bandana. Match reference texture, shading, proportions and illumination.
Text (verbatim): "12:34" printed in white on the front of the red bandana.
Constraints: real transparent background and genuine alpha; no floor, shadow, stone, motion trail, duplicate limbs, ghosting, extra objects, particles, glow, grid, labels, border or watermark. Only the single new intermediate sprite.
prompts.dino-stumble-06b:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one intermediate transparent dinosaur game animation sprite.
Input images: Image 1 is the previous halfway-up recovery pose, image 2 is the next upright reference pose. Draw ONE NEW pose at 65 percent of the way from image 1 toward image 2.
The dinosaur must now move its HEAD and CHEST clearly LEFT and UP from image 1 toward image 2, aligned almost like image 2. Use the exact face, cheek shape, big brown eyes and front-right three-quarter orientation of image 2. Keep the same body size as both references and the same feet placement/baseline as image 2. BOTH feet planted; knees only slightly bent, torso almost upright. Both hands LOW around the bottom of the cream belly, elbows just beginning to bend and curl the hands. No raised fists yet. Tail behind on viewer's LEFT like image 2.
Preserve exact green body, dark green back spikes and spots, cream muzzle/belly/toes, red cloth bandana with WHITE printed text "12:34". Same soft 3D rendering and shading.
Square transparent canvas. Full figure entirely visible with toes on y=0.965 of the canvas. Exactly two arms and two legs; no duplicate limbs, floor, shadow, objects, glow, outlines, labels, grid or watermark. Real alpha transparency. Only the single new intermediate sprite.
